qa_pairs.question: Which component has the highest torque specification in the automatic transmission shift console table?
qa_pairs.answer: The Bowden cable on shift tower/transmission at 15 Nm

qa_pairs.question: Which component has the lowest torque specification in this table?
qa_pairs.answer: The switch to shift console at 4.5 Nm

qa_pairs.question: What section of the manual does this page belong to?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 25-2 Shift Mechanism, specifically 25 16 Shift Console - Automatic Transmission

qa_pairs.question: How many different torque specifications are listed for the automatic transmission shift console components?
qa_pairs.answer: Five different torque specifications are listed: 15 Nm, 10 Nm, 7 Nm, 4.5 Nm, and 7 Nm
